thread:
liz (partnerships): Heads-up: SolarisOrbit (SI) submitted an intake for RetailCloud launch with a combined HW bundle. They want SI-first outreach + co-announce on marketplace. tagging @owen @mina @sara
owen (sales): Any AE ownership conflict? SFDC shows a contact but no active opp.
liz (partnerships): They claim discovery + testbed results. Asking for a 28-day exclusive claim and marketplace prep.
mina (field_engineer): If hardware procurement is in scope we need vendor lead times. Also need their perf report for our integration checklist.
sara (product_marketing): For announcements we require: NDA, mutual embargo, co-branded assets, and a launch timeline locked 3 weeks before publish. Marketplace listing takes ~3w after verification.
owen (sales): Proposed rules: Tier-1 SI -> 28d claim if evidence (demo OR test report OR PO). SLA: SI must respond to intro within 48h or they lose exclusivity. For net-new detection use SFDC match score <0.65 -> treat as net-new.
liz (partnerships): Operational mapping to intake webhook: claim_tag=si_claim:solarisorbit, claim_window_days=28, evidence_urls=[demo_url,test_report], response_sla_hours=48. Push to SFDC and create ticket.
mina (field_engineer): If HW qty >=10 escalate to ops for provisioning lead time check. Add tag hw_gating and integration_risk if custom kernel work required.
legalbot (bot): Created ticket PRT-6222: "SolarisOrbit SI claim + co-announce gating" assigned to partnerships, sales, ops, product.
liz (partnerships): Next steps: 1) @mina confirm perf/test evidence by EOD. 2) @owen open deal-desk thread for revenue split and attribution. 3) partnerships to send SI one-pager with claim terms and announcement checklist.
owen (sales): Will open deal-desk and loop in legal for revenue split template.
mina (field_engineer): Perf report uploaded to drive: https://gdrive.re/solarisorbit/retailcloud-perf. HW qty indicated = 12 with target ship 2026-07-10.
sara (product_marketing): I'll draft co-marketing checklist and embargo clause. Need legal to approve copy.
legalbot (bot): PRT-6222 updated: evidence added, claim_window=28d, response_sla=48h, tags=[si_handshake, hw_gating, marketplace].
liz (partnerships): Also setting a fast-fail: if SI misses evidence deadline (72h) or SLA, AE gets ownership immediately. Adding that to checklist.
owen (sales): Agreed. Add automated nudge cadence: day 0 intro, 48h nudge, 72h final.
liz (partnerships): Thanks all. I'll drop the one-pager into the ticket and ping SolarisOrbit to accept the co-sell TOU. :rocket:
